name: L3 特效流程
description: L3 特效制作流程：制作视觉特效、粒子效果、转场效果。输出 PNG 序列帧。需要 Windows MCP Runner。
author: Pipeline-Sys

nodes.name: 参数接收
nodes.expression: ({ task_id: inputs.task_id, title: inputs.title, vfx_type: inputs.vfx_type, vfx_name: inputs.vfx_name, frame_count: inputs.frame_count, dimensions: { width: inputs.width, height: inputs.height }, loop: inputs.loop, execution_runtime: 'windows', requires_mcp: true, output_format: 'PNG', started_at: new Date().toISOString() })

nodes.name: 加载能力系统规格
nodes.description: 读取能力系统规格获取特效需求

nodes.name: 生成特效提示词
nodes.description: 根据特效类型生成 AI 提示词
nodes.expression: (function() { const vfxType = '${inputs.vfx_type}'; const vfxName = '${inputs.vfx_name}'; const frameCount = ${inputs.frame_count}; const vfxDescriptions = { 'depth_perception': 'glowing cyan aura, rippling effect, dimensional scanning, transparent overlay', 'depth_intervention': 'orange energy burst, reality distortion, structural change, scar effect', 'time_intervention': 'purple temporal ripple, time rewind effect, clock fragments, paradox shimmer', 'zone_transition': 'pixel dissolve, scene fade, dimensional gate, portal effect', 'particle_ambient': 'floating dust particles, soft glow, atmospheric effect' }; const basePrompt = 'pixel art visual effect, cyberpunk style, alpha channel, ' + (vfxDescriptions[vfxName] || 'magical effect, energy glow'); const keyframes = []; for (let i = 0; i < frameCount; i++) { const progress = (i / (frameCount - 1)) * 100; keyframes.push({ frame: i + 1, prompt: basePrompt + ', animation frame ' + (i + 1) + '/' + frameCount + ', ' + progress.toFixed(0) + '% progress' }); } return { vfx_type: vfxType, vfx_name: vfxName, keyframes, total_frames: frameCount }; })()

nodes.name: 生成单帧特效
nodes.command:
echo 'Generating VFX frame ${loop.keyframe.frame}/${inputs.frame_count}'
echo 'Effect: ${inputs.vfx_name}'
echo 'Size: ${inputs.width}x${inputs.height}'
echo 'Output: assets/images/vfx/${inputs.vfx_name}/frame_${loop.keyframe.frame}.png'
# TODO: 实际调用 MCP 生成带透明通道的 PNG

nodes.name: 合成 Spritesheet
nodes.description: 将帧序列合成为带透明通道的 spritesheet
nodes.command:
echo 'Creating VFX spritesheet'
echo 'Effect: ${inputs.vfx_name}'
echo 'Frames: ${inputs.frame_count}'
echo 'Layout: ${inputs.frame_count}x1 grid'
echo 'Output: assets/images/spritesheets/vfx_${inputs.vfx_name}.png'
# TODO: 使用 ImageMagick 合成保留透明通道
# montage -background none frame_*.png -tile ${inputs.frame_count}x1 -geometry +0+0 spritesheet.png

nodes.name: 生成 Phaser 配置
nodes.description: 生成 Phaser 动画配置

nodes.name: 更新资源注册表
Git 提交
nodes.command: git add assets/images/vfx/ assets/images/spritesheets/ src/data/vfx/ src/data/asset-registry.json && git commit -m "${inputs.task_id}: ${inputs.title} [L3_vfx_artist]" && git push origin HEAD || echo 'No changes to commit'

body.title: 特效任务完成
